description: Fetch a file offer by file_id. Returns metadata plus content_base64. Does not write the file to disk. One-shot: after get the bytes are gone from the server. Peek that does not consume is GET /v1/files/{id}/copy (not this tool). Not idempotent.

file_id.description: File id from list_files or a file message.

name: get_file
title: Get file
